# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via the repository's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/ai-agent-permission-enforcer/security/advisories/new) feature. Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact. Do not include secrets or personal data that are not needed to reproduce the issue.

Maintainers aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide a resolution timeline after triage.
